description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name via an API endpoint, with a fallback mechanism. It includes two exported functions: fetchProjectNameDirect and fetchProjectNameByProjectId, the latter being a deprecated alias.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect
methods.description: Fetches the project name given a projectId, using either a client API or fallback to axios with base URL.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for compatibility.
